title: Gnome's Cap
wikitext: {{Infobox mousehat |name = Gnome's Cap |image = Gnome's Cap.png |achievement = Craft Master |ad = [[Crafting|Craft]] every item. |price = {{Price|5000}} }} The '''Gnome's Cap''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be purchased from the [[Abandoned House]] for {{Price|5000}} after earning the "Craft Master" [[Achievements|Achievement]] ([[Crafting|craft]] every item). It can also be obtained from [[Desert Festival#Emily's Outfit Services|Emily's outfit services]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. There is a ≈2% chance to receive the gender-neutral outfit with the Gnome's Cap. ==Notes== * The Gnome's Cap outfit also includes the [[File:Shirt034.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Green Tunic]] and [[File:Skirt.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Skirt]] (dyed RGB value 41,114,22). ==Trivia== * This hat bears a striking resemblance to Link's cap from "[[wikipedia:The Legend of Zelda|The Legend of Zelda]]" game series. ==References== Male players have 47 possible outfits (1/47 ≈ 2.13%), while female players have 48 possible ones (1/48 ≈ 2.08%). See Content\Data\MakeoverOutfits.xnb. [[wikipedia:RGB color model|RGB]] refers to "Red,Green,Blue". ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.6|Purchase price increased from {{Price|1000}} to {{Price|5000}}.
